headline: Bootcamp Apps
introText: Here you will find an overview of the full-stack applications developed during the intensive program and deployed on a dedicated vServer infrastructure.

darkbay.title: DarkBay – Digital Auction House
darkbay.description:
A fully functional full-stack auction platform for pirates. Developed as a high-performance Single Page Application with an Angular frontend and a robust NestJS backend within a monorepo. The application features secure JWT authentication, real-time validation, and a relational MariaDB database connection via TypeORM.

Go to Live App

cyber-chat.title: Cyber-Chat API
cyber-chat.description:
A modern backend project demonstrating a secure REST API architecture with NestJS. The application implements complete user management, including encrypted authentication and role-based access control. The entire infrastructure is documented and tested via an interactive OpenAPI/Swagger interface.

Go to API Documentation (Swagger)

itLibrary.title: IT Book Library
itLibrary.description:
A web-based library application for managing and personalizing IT literature. The project was implemented using native TypeScript and interacts dynamically with a REST API (Bookmonkey API). Users can search the entire book catalog, retrieve detailed information, and save favorite books to an individual watchlist.

Go to Live App

trailGuide.title: Trail-Guide Hiking Planner
trailGuide.description:
An interactive route planner for hiking enthusiasts to efficiently manage trails and regions. The application is built on Node.js and Express, utilizes server-side HTML templating for the views, and stores all route data in an integrated SQLite database. The project is fully containerized and run via Docker.

Go to Live App

themeCreator.title: Theme Creator
themeCreator.description:
An intuitive web tool for UI/UX developers to dynamically create and preview color schemes. Built with React and TailwindCSS, the app enables real-time experimentation with color palettes and saves user-defined themes directly to the browser's LocalStorage.

Go to Live App

rickAndMorty.title: Rick & Morty Explorer
rickAndMorty.description:
A reactive web application to explore the entire multiverse of the well-known sci-fi series. The frontend was developed with React and TypeScript, integrating the official Rick & Morty REST API. Features include high-performance filtering, live search, and client-side paging of characters.

Go to Live App

artGallery.title: Digital Art Gallery
artGallery.description:
An interactive online exhibition showcasing selected artworks. Realized as a lightweight frontend project using native JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and modern CSS3. The focus lies on dynamic DOM manipulation during exhibit loading and a responsive layout for mobile devices.

Go to Live App

quizGame.title: Quiz Game
quizGame.description:
An engaging, browser-based trivia game with dynamic score evaluation. The game is entirely based on Vanilla JavaScript. The question catalogs are structured and stored in JSON files, loaded asynchronously at runtime, and visually presented through an animated user interface.

Go to Live App
